description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the merging ratio of direct assessment and pairwise ranking methods and two performance metrics: Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation and Pairwise Ranking Accuracy. The x-axis represents the merging ratio, labeled as "(Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio," and ranges from 1.9 to 9.1 with tick labels at regular intervals of approximately 1.0. The y-axis on the left, labeled "Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation," ranges from 0.500 to 0.675 and uses a linear scale. The y-axis on the right, labeled "Pairwise Ranking Accuracy," ranges from 50 to 75 and also uses a linear scale, with tick marks corresponding to the values 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, and 75. Three lines are plotted: the green line, representing "Direct Assessment Correlation," starts at approximately 0.500 at a merging ratio of 1.9 and rises to a peak of approximately 0.670 at a merging ratio of 5.5 before declining to approximately 0.600 at 9.1; the blue line, representing "Pairwise Ranking Accuracy," starts at approximately 0.670 at a merging ratio of 1.9, peaks at approximately 0.670 at 5.5, and then declines sharply to approximately 0.480 at 9.1; the black line, representing "Average Performance," starts at approximately 0.575 at a merging ratio of 1.9, rises to a peak of approximately 0.625 at 5.5, and then declines to approximately 0.530 at 9.1.
